capabilities: Save an Obsidian Markdown note as a draft on supported platforms
Update existing drafts via platform bindings written to note frontmatter
Pair with a Chromium extension that fills the logged-in editor on browser platforms
Convert Markdown with themes and inline styles for WeChat-safe output
Store the WeChat AppSecret in Obsidian SecretStorage
extras: Only WeChat Official Account works with the Obsidian plugin alone; the other twelve platforms require installing the separate Chromium extension ZIP. The plugin is awaiting Obsidian community directory review, and several browser platforms have passed only offline fixture tests, not real-account verification. README is provided in both English and Chinese.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to push a single Markdown note as drafts to multiple external publishing platforms while keeping the note as the source of truth.

relations.evidence: The platform list, Markdown/HTML output differences, and draft-idempotency approach were informed by wechatsync/Wechatsync.

requires.name: Chromium extension (Chrome or Edge) for the twelve browser platforms
WeChat Official Account AppID and AppSecret
logged-in accounts on the target platforms

summary: Local-first plugin plus companion Chromium extension that creates or updates drafts of a Markdown note on Chinese content platforms; it saves drafts only.
